styleText: Steampunk over the ruins of the Old World: brass and steam, airships over Lisbon and Geneva, the glow of etherite, the Steam League, orcish Ghar. Orchestral-mechanical: strings and brass with ticking clockwork percussion, a pipe organ hum, accordion and Portuguese guitar colours, 19th-century adventure romance with a touch of melancholy.

rows.prompt: Ambient sound, no music: a forest at night: crickets, an owl, a branch creaking, wind in the canopy. The world: Steampunk over the ruins of the Old World. Natural field-recording texture, steady and even, suitable as a quiet background loop. A steady ambience from the first second to the last, no intro, no fade-out, so it loops. Variation 2: a different mix of the same sounds.
